title: PointCloudLabeler — Tree segmentation and forest inventory from terrestrial and mobile laser scans
description: An out-of-core, octree-streaming point-cloud editor for forestry research. Turns raw terrestrial and mobile laser scans into traceable per-tree measurements (height, DBH, stem taper, basal area, crown metrics, biomass, carbon) with end-to-end uncertainty propagation and an occlusion-aware confidence figure on every quantity.
